options.name: content
options.description: Popup content; strings render as text.

options.name: title
options.description: Visible heading; names the popup through aria-labelledby. Either title or label is required.

options.name: label
options.description: aria-label when there is no title.

options.name: placement
options.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

options.name: offset
options.description: Gap between trigger and popup, px.

options.name: closeOnEscape
options.description: Escape requests close (cancelable). Escape is consumed while the popover is topmost either way.

options.name: closeOnOutsidePointer
options.description: Pointer down outside the popup and trigger requests close (cancelable).

options.name: initialFocus
options.description: Where focus goes on open: first tabbable element (falls back to the container), the popup container, or nowhere.

options.name: showCloseButton
options.description: Render a localized close button in the header.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show, position, and move focus per initialFocus.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close programmatically (not cancelable). Focus inside the popup returns to the trigger.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; repositions when open.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close if open; remove the popup, trigger ARIA attributes, listeners, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: After the popup opened (dispatched on the popup element).

events.name: aui-cancel
events.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open.

cssClasses.name: aui-popover--static
cssClasses.description: Set when animation is disabled globally.

cssClasses.name: aui-popover__header
cssClasses.description: Title row with the optional close button.
